Holam before vav and holam haser for vav

The first two groups show all 17 occurrences in 16 verses of MAM where a non-vav letter has a holam dot and the next letter is vav; combining marks may intervene. These groups exclude the divine name, including prefixed occurrences.

The third group, "Holam haser for vav", shows all 416 occurrences in 390 verses of the separate Unicode character HOLAM HASER FOR VAV (U+05BA). Each is on vav; another following vav is not required.

In the first two groups, the blue text marks the holam-bearing letter and following vav. In the third group, it marks the vav with holam haser. The original marks remain on their original letters. Each occurrence is enlarged and shown with "Normal spacing" and "Expanded spacing"; only the letter spacing differs.

In "With an above-mark on vav": zaqef qatan: 3; revia: 1.
